compiled_by: research/costs review, web search this session (see each record's source_url + note); orchestrator review 2026-09-22 filled the SEBI/NSE/DP spans from the sources cited per record and closed the 2024-09-30 NSE gap
usage_note: Every component is a list of time-boxed records: effective_from is inclusive, effective_to is exclusive (null = open-ended / still current as of compiled_at). resolve a rate for a leg by picking the record whose window contains the leg's trade date, matching segment/exchange/side where those keys exist. A record with verified=false is a best-effort placeholder from partial or conflicting secondary sources: it must not be trusted for production tax/cost filings and should be re-confirmed against the primary circular before use. This file intentionally leaves gaps rather than inventing a rate or a change date.

stt.description: Securities Transaction Tax, Chapter VII Finance (No. 2) Act 2004, as amended. Equity delivery: both sides. Equity intraday (non-delivery): sell side only. The 25% STT hike of 1-Apr-2023 and the Budget-2024 hike effective 1-Oct-2024 applied ONLY to futures & options; equity delivery/intraday cash-segment STT was not touched by either change.

records.note: 0.1% delivery buy-side STT is the long-standing cash-equity rate (in force since 2013) and is corroborated by every current explainer found this session (Zerodha, Bajaj Broking, LegalClarity, StockGro, 2025 STT guides). No change to the cash-equity delivery rate was found for 2021-2026; the 1-Apr-2023 and 1-Oct-2024 STT hikes were confirmed (multiple sources, e.g. business-standard 123032400585) to apply only to F&O. Treated as a single unbroken record for the whole window; if an undiscovered interim change exists it is not reflected here.
Same basis as the BUY-side delivery record above.
No STT on the buy leg of an intraday (non-delivery) equity trade.
0.025% intraday sell-side STT; confirmed current for 2025/2026 and reported as unchanged by the 1-Oct-2024 F&O-only hike (taxclue.in 2025 STT guide).

exchange_txn_charge.description: NSE cash-market transaction charge, levied on both buy and sell value. This is the component with the most churn: an IPFT-linked 6% hike (eff. 1-Jan-2021), a partial rollback (~Mar-2023), a further ~1% cut (from 1-Apr-2024), and a SEBI 'true-to-label' uniform-charge reform (eff. 1-Oct-2024) all happened inside the coverage window, and the intermediate numeric values could not all be pinned down from the sources found this session.

sebi_fee.description: SEBI turnover / regulatory fee under the SEBI (Regulation of Fee for Registered Stock Brokers) Regulations, levied on both buy and sell value.

records.note: SEBI press release (Apr 2020): broker turnover fee 'reduced to 50% of the existing fee structure for the period June 2020 to March 2021'; existing fee Rs 10/crore -> Rs 5/crore through 2021-03-31.
Rs 10/crore after the COVID relief lapsed (2021-04-01); confirmed current on zerodha.com/charges 2026-09-19; no change found in between.

gst.description: GST on brokerage + SEBI turnover fee + exchange transaction charge (services supplied by the stock broker/exchange are taxable supplies under the CGST/SGST Acts).

records.note: 18% GST on broking services has been the rate since the GST regime's 1-Jul-2017 start; no rate change was found or expected inside the 2021-2026 window. 'applies_to' documents Zerodha's own GST base (brokerage+SEBI+exchange charge, per the fill_costs() formula being reproduced) -- this is a broker/engine convention, not itself a distinct statutory choice, and other rule sets (e.g. prd-illustrative-v1) may legitimately use a narrower base.

stamp_duty.description: Stamp duty on transfer of securities, Indian Stamp Act 1899 as amended by the Finance Act 2019, collected by the exchange/clearing corporation on the buy side only, uniform pan-India since 1-Jul-2020.

records.note: 0.015% on delivery buy value, effective 1-Jul-2020 (predates this window) per the PIB press release on the Finance Act 2019 stamp-duty amendments and corroborated by PwC's contemporaneous client alert and Zerodha's Z-Connect explainer. No change found within 2021-2026.
0.003% on intraday (non-delivery) buy value, same 1-Jul-2020 origin and no change found within 2021-2026.

dp_charge.description: Depository Participant (DP) sell-side charge, i.e. CDSL's per-debit fee plus the broker's own markup and GST. NOT a government statutory rate (SEBI/CDSL regulate CDSL's own leg only) and varies by broker; included here at the task's request, sourced for Zerodha specifically and labelled as such.

records.note: CDSL moved to a flat Rs 3.50/debit transaction charge effective 1-Oct-2024 (CDSL media release, 26-Sep-2024). Zerodha's all-in Rs 15.34/scrip/sell-day (Rs 3.50 CDSL + Rs 9.50 Zerodha markup + Rs 2.34 GST) is confirmed by a live zerodha.com/charges fetch this session and matches the frozen zerodha-equity-v1 model.
